screens.title: Sign-in
screens.intro: Connect to a Server from a compact pane on the canvas. Saved URLs ellipsize; selecting one applies the stored sign-in.

screens.title: Workspaces
screens.intro: Each checkout stays identifiable on the rail. Desktop shows the selected workspace overview; Mobile lists the same rows on their own screen.

screens.title: Applications
screens.intro: Each tab is a running application surface. Desktop opens the allocated HTTP port; Mobile lists Apps in the workspace bottom bar.

screens.title: Console
screens.intro: Application stdout lives next to the running app, including [install] output. This surface is Desktop chrome; Mobile does not host a console.

screens.title: Git
screens.intro: Working-tree review. Desktop Git changes and Mobile Git show the same change tree. Neither surface mutates the agent commit queue.

screens.title: Review
screens.intro: Mobile Review reads the Server-owned proposal queue. It does not reconstruct ancestry or infer verification state locally.

screens.title: History
screens.intro: A bounded commit log with graph lanes, a pinned timestamp column, and a sticky selected-commit detail.

screens.title: File viewer
screens.intro: Readonly inspection of a changed file: hunk jumps, line kinds, and syntax tokens. It is not a second editor.

screens.title: Agents
screens.intro: Desktop Agent is the live ACP session. Mobile Agents is the picker that opens that session.

screens.title: Diagnostics
screens.intro: Paginated audit rows for the selected application: process, browser, and health evidence. Desktop hosts this next to Console and Metrics.

screens.title: Metrics
screens.intro: CPU, memory, and request duration for the selected application, on quieter metrics cards rather than a dashboard theme.

screens.title: Validation
screens.intro: Recorded GUI flows live in a right sidebar on the selected application. Greater steps nest micro-checks; pass and fail roll up. The rail starts collapsed.

screens.title: Database
screens.intro: Query the application database from the same application chrome, with a selected table and a run control.

screens.title: Capabilities
screens.intro: Enable Server-owned modules. Desktop uses an overlay; Mobile Settings is the same list on the workspace tab. Clients never talk to the remote registry.

screens.title: Agent chat
screens.intro: The live transcript. Desktop hosts it in the Agent tab; Mobile opens it as an inner page from the Agents picker, mounting the same AgentUp.Chat module the sign-in harness drives.

screens.title: Application space
screens.intro: One application's own interface. Desktop connects a WebView to the allocated port; Mobile reaches the same surface through the Server's authenticated proxy.

screens.title: Workspace list
screens.intro: Every registered checkout on one screen, with the clone action. Mobile gives this its own route; Desktop keeps the same rows on the rail.
